name: Fractal Dimension Regime Gate
note: Keeps FRAMA's internal Hausdorff-style dimension estimate and throws away the moving average FRAMA exists to produce. D compares the summed range of two half-windows against the range of the whole: near 1 for a monotone path, near 2 for a space-filling one, so it measures how much of the distance travelled was retraced. D is direction-blind by construction, so the side is supplied separately by close[t] against close[t-N]. Exits when D turns noise-like again or the N-bar price comparison flips against the position.
source: John F. Ehlers, 'FRAMA - Fractal Adaptive Moving Average' (mesasoftware.com/papers/FRAMA.pdf). The N1/N2/N3 definitions and D = log((N1+N2)/N3)/log(2) verified against QuantConnect/Lean, Indicators/FractalAdaptiveMovingAverage.cs. Using D alone as a standalone regime gate is the harvester's synthesis.
